contact.basis: Original public ground at the modeled approach to the original roofed core.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed original site-context frame with explicitly approximate component registration. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM. 1.5 m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.
Composite source relief can contain water-level, canopy and DEM void artifacts; it is not bathymetry or an exposed foundation survey. Source field does not certify historic ground contact.
